purpose: Auditable capture selection from the complete fifth Kiro-fixes rehearsal; this is throwaway-copy evidence, not a claim that staging was deployed.

safety_evidence.snapshot_scope: Throwaway rehearsal copy only; these are not staging recovery snapshots.

prior_visual_comparison.note: The selected prior captures were visually reviewed. Run 4 itself was incomplete and INVALID; matching captures do not turn that run into a passing gate.

visual_assessment.conclusion: No new visible blocker in the changed selected captures or the freshly inspected key samples. Privacy Client disclosure remains open and aligned below the strip, with the rail outside its box. Thai research text and controls are readable; full Work With Me titles remain visible.
observed_limits: Transient Privacy rail labels can temporarily cover a small amount of body text.
At 150% root font size, the site brand wraps awkwardly and fewer research bullets are visible.
Landscape reading cards can cover part of the title strip, while staying below the pinned header.
Summary fades at the bottom indicate further scrollable content.
visual_assessment.scope: Fresh current-run viewing is recorded per image. Other retained images are exact SHA256 matches of previously reviewed run-4 captures. Unretained images were inventoried and hashed, not individually reviewed by this audit.

validation_limits: Browser automation and CDP touch are not physical-device validation.
Root font-size changes are not true OS text scaling.
VoiceOver, TalkBack and other assistive technology were not validated.
No WebKit or real Safari validation is claimed.
Static captures do not independently establish gesture behavior; completed interaction logs provide that evidence.
